item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your calendar is full of reminders about perspective, positivity, and calm, and all of that runs better on a body that has enough water. Dehydration makes you foggy and short-tempered, which is exactly when old patterns creep back in. Pair water with your existing anchors: a glass before meditation, one at midday, one with your afternoon walk. Action: drink a full glass of water right now.
